front.title: The JSON vCon - Tool Invocation Extension

abstract.t: A vCon is a container for data and information relating to a conversation. This document defines an extension to the JSON vCon schema for recording the policy decisions of AI agents and their invocation of tools. Before an agent performs an operation, the agent or its host uses policy to decide whether the operation is allowed, disallowed or requires permission. This document defines an Event Object type for those decisions, and Event Object types for each step of a tool invocation. It also outlines requirements for recording requests for permission and direction, which need to be defined in a future document.
